name: v6.17.0
body:
## What's Changed

  ### ✨ Features
  - **OpenAPI 3.2 support**: fixes OAS 3.2 schema validation and aligns it with 3.0/3.1 by @AnastasiiaSvietlova in #3033
  - **AsyncAPI 3.1.0**: updated to the latest AsyncAPI version by @danielkocot in #3019

  ### 🐛 Bug Fixes
  - **rulesets:** restore null guard in `duplicated-entry-in-enum` (#2959) by @slegarraga in #2963
  - **rulesets:** clarify the `operationId` URL validation message by @slegarraga in #3035
  - **formatters:** include all results in markdown output by @slegarraga in #3039
  - **formatters:** include ruleset-based `documentationUrl` in the github format by @ctreatma in #3063
  - **core:** make JSON Schemas in `packages/core/src/ruleset/meta` valid by @jviotti in #2788
  - **repo:** report download failures in `install.sh` by @Sunasuna24 in #3041

  ### 🔒 Security
  - **repo:** prevent script injection in the `release-docker` workflow by @kopernic-pl in #3024
  - **repo:** pin actions and update workflow references by @kopernic-pl in #3025

  ### 📚 Documentation
  - Document default severity for builtin rules by @slegarraga in #3036
  - Show how to extend builtin rulesets in the JS API by @slegarraga in #3037
  - **cli:** note the `github-actions` formatter version requirement by @slegarraga in #3038
  - Add Bank API to the readme by @erwinkramer in #2806

  ### 🧰 Tooling & Maintenance
  - Upgrade ESLint 8 → 10 with flat config migration by @kopernic-pl in #3021
  - Upgrade TypeScript to 4.9.5 by @micryc in #3078
  - Un-pin the rollup version range by @AnastasiiaSvietlova in #3042
  - Drop Node.js 18 and 20 from the test matrix by @Patrycja-dz in #3053
  - Remove `devcontainer.json` and Dockerfile by @kopernic-pl in #3061
  - Add a minor release trigger by @micryc in #3079

- `addRules` and `addFunctions` have been deprecated, use `setRules` and `setFunctions` instead

### Fixed
- CLI: relative paths to documents are supported [#474](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/issues/474)

# [2.0.0](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/compare/v1.2.0...v2.0.0) (2019-03-28)

### Features

* Added a CLI for linting without needing to play with JavaScript (#105)
* Use json-ref-parser by default to provide dereferenced object, ([#99](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/issues/99))
* Add file paths and line numbers to results, used for CLI output ([#106](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/issues/106) & [#117](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/issues/117)) 
* Show YAML parsing errors as results ([#118](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/issues/118)) 

### BREAKING CHANGES

* The `spectral.run()` method is now async, so add the `await` keyword before it
* The `spectral.run()` method now returns an array of results, instead of an object containing an array
* Removed `schema-items-is-object` rule ([#100](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/issues/100)) ([2e5902f](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/commit/2e5902f))


**Before**
```js
const resolved = someCustomResolver(specification);
const results = spectral.run(specification, { resolvedTarget: resolved });
console.log(results.results) // [ { ... } ]
```

**After**

```js
const results = await spectral.run(specification);
console.log(results) // [ { ... } ]
```

This is a big simplification to the API, as it will resolve things for you (internal $ref only, so any $ref which is pointing to a location within the same file). 

_The ability to pass in other resolvers to support external references or other resolving strategies will come in future versions._

### Features

* add an option to set rules that allow complete reset ([35bbf42](https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/commit/35bbf42))

* published build will no longer be nested in `dist`, which means old deep imports e.g. `@stoplight/spectral/dist/rulesets` should now be `@stoplight/spectral/rulesets`.

- use our standard build process, file conventions, and commit conventions
- relaxes some of the deps
* rule's name changed.

Is: "{format}-{name}"
